name: Customer conversation request writer
why: Writes warm and cold invitations to talk, a starting point for the honest outreach in the interview recruiting and consent skill.

name: Buying story interview guide
why: A timeline script from first thought to first use, matching the story-based questions in the discussion guide prompt.

name: Interview customers and map what they hire you to do
why: Runs from interview questions to jobs and buyer profile, the same arc as the customer interview round workflow.

name: Customer conversation notes sorter
why: Separates facts from praise and feature ideas in raw notes, the did-versus-said step of the synthesis skill.

name: Interview transcript trimmer
why: Cuts a long transcript down to the passages worth coding, useful before a big synthesis.

name: Build a buyer profile from interviews and reviews
why: Combines interviews and reviews into a job-based buyer profile and a writer's brief, an evidence-linked alternative to made-up personas.

name: Community evidence researcher
why: Codes posts and comments into counted, sourced themes and says what the sample cannot show, the core of mention mining.

name: Monthly customer voice keeper
why: Adds each month's new buyer words and doubts from reviews to a brand file, a light version of the monthly voice-of-customer workflow.

name: Weekly product feedback triager
why: Counts and sorts each week's feedback into yes, later or no, the fix-list end of feedback synthesis.

name: Find a product idea in buyer complaints and score it
why: Scores product ideas drawn from complaints, like the reach, pain and ease ranking in the review and mention mining skill.

name: Turn reviews into ad copy in your brand voice
why: Turns mined buyer words into ad copy with a fact check, the next step after the customer words swipe file.

name: Taster event planner
why: Plans a one-day tasting with taster cards and a decision rule, a quick start for the product trials part of the group sessions skill.

name: Check a marketing survey before sending it
why: Reviews survey questions for bias and plans the analysis, a check to run on the feedback survey prompt before sending.

name: Prepare a survey findings briefing
why: Turns survey results into a defensible briefing with sampling caveats, for NPS and feedback survey readouts.
